bio.text: Bennie G. Thompson has represented Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House since a special election on April 20, 1993; he is a native of Bolton, Mississippi.
He served as Bolton alderman from 1969 to 1972, mayor from 1973 to 1980, and Hinds County supervisor from 1980 to 1993.
Thompson earned a B.A. from Tougaloo College and an M.S. in educational administration from Jackson State University.
